item.title: 🟢 [jina] bge-reranker-v2-m3-free (Free)
item.description:
🎯 模型名称: bge-reranker-v2-m3-free

⚡ 运行状态: 🟢 正常可用 (Active)

🏢 归属/厂商 (owned_by): jina

🔌 支持端点类型: jina-rerank

📅 首次发现时间: 2026-08-21T13:17:57.120363+00:00

🕒 最后检测时间: 2026-09-02T08:19:25.635047+00:00

🌐 基础接入地址: https://www.dmxapi.cn/v1

💻 快速调用测试 (cURL):

curl https://www.dmxapi.cn/v1/rerank \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DMX_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "bge-reranker-v2-m3-free",
    "query": "What is artificial intelligence?",
    "documents": [
      "Artificial intelligence is intelligence demonstrated by machines.",
      "Organic food refers to food produced by methods complying with standards of organic farming."
    ]
  }'

提示：在 DMXAPI 控制台获取 API Key 后，将 $DMX_API_KEY 替换为您自己的密钥即可免费调用。
